decisions.reason: As a flagship biodynamic yogurt line closely tied to the firm's core organic dairy capabilities and still actively shown in 2024, it is likely meeting or at least staying near aspiration levels, so boundedly rational management would keep it.

This mild sliced cheese fits the established cheese business and core resources well, and as a very recent launch management would usually allow time for uncertain early results before reallocating resources unless performance clearly fell below aspiration.

This sliced butter cheese is also close to the firm's existing offer and production know-how, so with industry growth and some organizational slack the firm would most likely keep it for another year while learning about demand.
